Maya Li: Heads-up: Sandbox tenant 'AtlasLabs' queried their May bill, they show ~410k embed units in invoice but expect ~462k (about 11% lower). Can infra confirm ingestion around 2026-05-30T18:00Z-18:40Z?

Eli Chen: Checking kafka. Consumer group `metering-processor-sandbox` had a leader election at ~18:06Z and a short aggregator restart. I see a throughput dip and a small set of offsets that didn't get emitted. Filing dry-run.

Eli Chen: Dry-run command (internal):
```
./tools/reingest --topic meter-events --partitions 0-1 --start 5567000 --end 5569800 --filter tenant=atlaslabs --dry-run
```
Dry-run delta = +51,324 embed units. Estimated charge +$71.85 (@ $0.0014/unit). Checksums OK.

Zoe Martinez: <$5k so policy supports ledger backfill. Maya, Finance ok to proceed?

Maya Li: Approve backfill for undercount. Please include `ledger-adjustment:reason=ingest-replay-leader-election-sandbox`. Also confirm it's only sandbox tenant (no downstream billing impact).

Priya Kapoor: SRE confirms it's isolated to sandbox cluster and safe to replay in maintenance window. I'll run the write with monitoring.

billing-bot: NOTE: Ledger writes will generate an audit event. Ensure `ledger-adjustment:reason` is populated and include `adj-source` tag. KB: https://docs.redwood/internal/billing/ledger-adjustments

Eli Chen: Performing write now with maintenance lock. ETA ~30m.

Eli Chen: Write complete. Audit ADJ-2026-10412. Ledger +51,324 embed units for tenant atlaslabs posted. Adjustment queued for next invoice processing.

CSM-Ian: Notified AtlasLabs with standard blurb: "We reprocessed a short window of telemetry due to a transient processing restart and adjusted your usage ledger by +51,324 embed units. This will be reflected on your next invoice. Let us know if you prefer an immediate amendment." Customer replied thanks.

Maya Li: Thanks team. Closing once invoice queue finishes. :white_check_mark:
